name: dl-vo
text: Delhi is India's capital... [short pause] and it has almost no skyscrapers. [pause] Twenty kilometres away, Gurgaon and Noida are full of them. [short pause] So what's stopping Delhi? [pause] Reason one... [short pause] planes. Every building within twenty kilometres of the airport needs a height clearance. [pause] Reason two... [short pause] history. Delhi has a hundred and seventy-four protected monuments. Nothing new can be built within a hundred metres of them. [pause] Reason three... [short pause] the heart of the city, Lutyens' Delhi, is a bungalow zone. Low-rise, by design. [pause] So for years, Delhi's tallest building was... [short pause] a government office. About a hundred metres. [short pause] Noida's tallest is more than twice that. [pause] But in August 2026, Delhi's new master plan removed height limits across most of the city. [pause] So the skyline... [short pause] is about to change. [pause] Would you live on the fiftieth floor in Delhi?

name: dl-music

name: dl-sprawl
prompt: Vertical 9:16 photograph, shot on a full-frame camera, natural colour, cinematic documentary realism, fine detail, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no identifiable people.
